# Self-hosted site fonts

- Archivo Black 400 (Latin, normal): SIL Open Font License 1.1
- Familjen Grotesk variable (Latin, normal and italic): SIL Open Font License 1.1

The optimized WOFF2 files are sourced from the corresponding Fontsource packages. The upstream projects are [Archivo Black](https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/ArchivoBlack) and [Familjen Grotesk](https://github.com/fontsource/font-files/tree/main/fonts/google/familjen-grotesk).
